sections.title: drain nudges
sections.summary: FIFO advisory-nudge drain for one registered consumer.
sections.commentary: This drain path should preserve FIFO ordering and keep the daemon queue generic rather than client-specific.

sections.title: fetch nudges
sections.commentary: This snapshot path should read the current queued nudge state without draining it and keep client naming out of daemon ownership.

sections.title: register session
sections.commentary: This registration path should stay bounded and generic so client-specific naming does not leak into daemon ownership.

sections.title: unregister session
sections.commentary: This teardown path should remove bounded consumer state cleanly and report not-found or runtime errors explicitly.

sections.title: atm read
sections.commentary: This read path selects a candidate row from SQLite mailbox metadata, loads full content only for the chosen message, and writes back read/ack state through unified message-state persistence when display mutations are required.

sections.title: atm ack
sections.summary: Ack-state mutation and optional reply creation.
sections.commentary: This path should mutate only status plus any explicit reply row, then run post-commit effects without changing durable truth on hook or nudge failure.

sections.title: atm send
sections.summary: Compose and persist one message, then run post-commit effects.
sections.commentary: This path should validate input, commit SQLite first, then run post-commit hooks or advisory nudges without letting any side effect outrun durable truth.
